facts.what: 为惩罚自己关掉锅炉、穿多层，认为谎言是纯自私的编造
facts.anchor: A complete fabrication as a result of pure selfishness.

facts.what: 私信：感谢解读、承认上次像混蛋、不期待回复
facts.anchor: Cassie, it’s Finlay Munro. I’m not sure if you’ll remember me, but I just wanted to thank you for the reading.

facts.what: 第二条：想再见她、约喝酒
facts.anchor: I’d really like to see you again. Do you fancy a drink sometime?

facts.what: 自责让 Finlay 相信女友已死是背叛他与自己；但看到消息又动心
facts.anchor: the minute I allowed Finlay to believe his girlfriend was dead, I’d be betraying not only him but myself

facts.what: 随手翻书得到 Hafiz 句「Run…」，她读成要离开现有生活、奔向 Finlay
facts.anchor: ‘Run, my dear, from anything that may not strengthen your precious, budding wings.’ – Hafiz.

facts.what: 澄清不是想再解读，只是想 hang out
facts.anchor: I didn’t actually mean another reading.

facts.what: 决定去赴约，认定宇宙与 Hafiz 都已发话
facts.anchor: Cassie Torrance shall go to the ball with Finlay Munro.

relations: Finlay 主动重新联系；Cassie 把赴约读成命运
